executeRequires: Cloudflare API credentials and Terraform variables
Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry health endpoints
Node.js >=22.0.0, terraform, psql, and pnpm local tools

deployment.planMode: Validate manifests, readiness gates, and Worker dry-run rollout.
deployment.executeMode: Deploy Workers, queues, apps, migrations, health gates, and rollback contracts.

cloudflare.planMode: Validate Wrangler and Terraform queue contracts without provider mutation.
cloudflare.executeMode: Apply Cloudflare queue/storage topology and deploy Workers with rollback evidence.

supabase.planMode: Validate operational, certification, and SDLC lifecycle migrations plus verification SQL.
supabase.executeMode: Run production verification SQL against Supabase/Postgres for operational and SDLC lifecycle tables.

observability.planMode: Validate OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and Grafana configuration.
observability.executeMode: Verify collector, Prometheus rules, Grafana health, and telemetry endpoints.

incident.planMode: Validate incident routes, metadata, severity model, and runbooks.
incident.executeMode: Record incident drill timelines and recovery verification through operations API.

security.planMode: Validate webhook signatures, CSRF, auth rate limits, SBOM, audit, and secret rotation contracts.
security.executeMode: Rotate secrets, run security gates, and record enforcement evidence.

dashboards.planMode: Validate Grafana dashboards and platform console live API contracts.
dashboards.executeMode: Verify dashboard live data and record dashboard snapshots.

control-plane.planMode: Validate deployment, tenant, queue, and runtime command schemas.
control-plane.executeMode: Execute authorized control commands and record runtime audit evidence.
